parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover of 'Pig in Mud'. Ask your child: What do you see? Point to the pictures and name things together. This book practices words like: pig, mud, big, run, wet.
parent_tips.during_reading: Point to each word as you read. Help your child find Pig on each page. When you see words like pig, mud, big, run, wet, sound them out slowly together.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: What did Pig do? Can you find your favorite picture? Let's say some of the words together: pig, mud, big, run, wet.
